protocol.latencyDefinition: beforeinput event to the first requestAnimationFrame callback; this is a browser scheduling measurement, not a native-device input latency guarantee

reproduction.setup: Install the lockfile dependencies and the Playwright Chromium browser. Build and serve each revision with Vite preview on a separate port. The baseline was exported with git archive and built independently; the current profiler script supplied the identical fixture to both revisions.
reproduction.cpuProfile: An optional --profile argument writes a Chrome CPU profile for diagnosis. Full CPU profiles are not committed.

interpretation: These are headless Chromium production-bundle measurements on Linux with 4x CPU throttling, not measurements from a physical Android device.
Latency ends at the first requestAnimationFrame callback after beforeinput; it does not measure hardware keyboard delay or completed GPU paint.
The comparison uses one baseline run and two fresh-browser after runs. Individual runs are retained instead of presenting their average as a pooled latency distribution.
Elapsed time includes the fixed key delay and the 1200ms settling period. Machine timing is diagnostic evidence, not a pass/fail test threshold.
